question: Should this 1Password broker become a bundled OpenClaw plugin, or ship externally through ClawHub using the existing plugin SDK seams?
rationale: The existing seams appear sufficient for external distribution, while bundling creates an ongoing credentials, external-process, support, and security-review obligation that requires explicit ownership.

options.title: Ship Externally
options.body: Publish the broker as an external plugin while retaining its tool, approval, state, CLI, and documentation design.

options.title: Sponsor Bundling
options.body: Keep it bundled with explicit ownership, both blocker fixes, dependency review, and redacted live security proof before merge.

options.title: Pause The Direction
options.body: Defer implementation until maintainers establish a broader shared contract for agent-initiated secret access.

recommendation.title: Ship Externally
recommendation.body: Publish the broker as an external plugin while retaining its tool, approval, state, CLI, and documentation design.

likelyOwner.reason: The secops context and ownership of the linked feature make this person the clearest available owner for the distribution and security-boundary decision.
